khmer: សំណើ / ណែនាំ
breakdown: 建(build)+议(discuss, 讠speech radical) — building an idea in speech

examples.py: Wǒ jiànyì nǐ zǎo diǎn xiūxi.
Zhè shì yí ge hǎo jiànyì.

examples.en: The teacher suggests we practice more.

examples.py: Wǒ jiēshòu le tā de jiànyì.

breakdown: 将(about to)+来(come) — what is about to come

examples.en: What do you want to do in the future?
In the future I want to be a teacher.

examples.py: Jiānglái de shì hěn nán shuō.
examples.en: Future things are hard to say.
For the future, work hard now.

examples.py: Tā duì jiānglái hěn yǒu xìnxīn.
examples.en: He is confident about the future.

khmer: ប្រាក់រង្វាន់
breakdown: 奖(award)+金(money) — award money

examples.en: How much is the prize money?
The company gives bonuses at year end.

examples.py: Wǒ yòng jiǎngjīn mǎi le jiājù.
examples.en: I bought furniture with the bonus.

khmer: បន្ថយ / បញ្ចុះ
breakdown: 降(descend)+低(low) — bringing something down low
降(descend)+落(fall) — coming down and settling

examples.en: What time does the plane land?

examples.cn: 因为天气，飞机不能降落。
examples.py: Yīnwèi tiānqì, fēijī bù néng jiàngluò.
examples.en: Because of weather the plane can't land.

examples.cn: 降落的时候请系好安全带。
examples.py: Jiàngluò de shíhou qǐng jì hǎo ānquándài.
examples.en: Please fasten your seatbelt during landing.

khmer: ប្រគល់ / ចង
breakdown: Whole shape — two lines crossing, like handing over

examples.py: Qǐng bǎ zuòyè jiāo gěi lǎoshī.
examples.en: Please hand the homework to the teacher.

examples.py: Wǒ jiāo le hěn duō péngyou.
Wǒ bǎ cáiliào jiāo shàngqù le.

khmer: ផ្លាស់ប្ដូរយោបល់
breakdown: 交(exchange)+流(flow, 氵water radical) — ideas flowing back and forth

examples.cn: 跟外国人交流很有意思。
examples.py: Gēn wàiguó rén jiāoliú hěn yǒu yìsi.

breakdown: 交(cross)+通(pass through) — things crossing and passing

examples.en: Traffic is jammed in the morning.

examples.py: Jiāoqū de jiāotōng bú tài fāngbiàn.
examples.en: Transport in the suburbs isn't convenient.

breakdown: 郊(outskirts)+区(area) — the outer area

examples.en: Houses in the suburbs are cheaper.
The air in the suburbs is fresh.

examples.cn: 从郊区到市中心要一小时。
examples.py: Cóng jiāoqū dào shì zhōngxīn yào yì xiǎoshí.
examples.en: It takes an hour from the suburbs to downtown.
On weekends we walk in the suburbs.

khmer: មោទនភាព / ក្រអឺតក្រទម
breakdown: 骄(proud, 马horse radical)+傲(haughty) — sitting tall like on a horse

examples.en: Parents are proud of their children.

examples.py: Jiāo'ào huì ràng rén bú jìnbù.

breakdown: 饺(dumpling, 饣food radical)+子(noun suffix)

examples.py: Guò jié de shíhou chī jiǎozi.
Zhè jiā diàn de jiǎozi hěn yǒumíng.
Wǒ diǎn le liǎng fèn jiǎozi.
examples.en: I ordered two portions of dumplings.

khmer: សាស្ត្រាចារ្យ
breakdown: 教(teach)+授(confer, pass on) — one who teaches and passes on

examples.en: The professor is in the office.

examples.cn: 我想请教授看我的材料。
examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng jiàoshòu kàn wǒ de cáiliào.
examples.en: I want the professor to look at my materials.

breakdown: 教(teach)+育(raise, nurture) — teaching and raising

examples.py: Tā shòu guo hěn hǎo de jiàoyù.

breakdown: 接(receive)+受(receive) — two receiving characters together

examples.en: This result is hard to accept.

examples.py: Tā jiēshòu le zhè fèn gōngzuò.

khmer: បន្តបន្ទាប់
breakdown: 接(connect)+着(continuing) — connecting on to what came before

examples.cn: 接着发生了一件奇怪的事。
examples.py: Jiēzhe fāshēng le yí jiàn qíguài de shì.

khmer: បុណ្យ / វគ្គ
breakdown: 艹(grass radical)+卩 — a joint in bamboo, so a section or holiday

examples.py: Chūnjié shì Zhōngguó zuì dà de jié.
examples.en: Spring Festival is China's biggest holiday.

examples.py: Zhè yì jié nèiróng hěn zhòngyào.
Dì yī jié kè bā diǎn kāishǐ.
examples.en: The first class starts at eight.

examples.cn: 过节的时候大家都很开心。
examples.py: Guò jié de shíhou dàjiā dōu hěn kāixīn.

breakdown: 节(restrain)+约(restrict) — holding back on use

examples.en: He is good at saving money.

breakdown: 结(bear, tie)+果(fruit) — the fruit that comes out

examples.py: Jiéguǒ hé wǒ gūjì de yíyàng.

examples.cn: 不管结果如何，我努力了。
examples.py: Bùguǎn jiéguǒ rúhé, wǒ nǔlì le.

breakdown: 解(untie)+释(release, clarify) — untying a knot of confusion

examples.py: Zhè jiàn shì hěn nán jiěshì.

breakdown: 尽(to the utmost)+管(control) — no matter how much you control it

examples.py: Jǐnguǎn hěn lèi, tā háishi jiānchí.

examples.en: Feel free to ask me any questions.

examples.cn: 尽管下雨，我们还是去了。
examples.py: Jǐnguǎn xià yǔ, wǒmen háishi qù le.
examples.en: Although it rained, we still went.

examples.cn: 尽管他年轻，经验却很多。
examples.py: Jǐnguǎn tā niánqīng, jīngyàn què hěn duō.
examples.en: Although young, he has much experience.
Just say so if you need help.

breakdown: 紧(tight)+张(stretch) — stretched tight

examples.en: Don't be nervous, relax a bit.

examples.py: Tā jǐnzhāng de shuō bu chū huà.
examples.en: He was too nervous to speak.

english: to carry out; to be in progress
breakdown: 进(advance)+行(go) — moving forward with something

examples.py: Wǒmen jìnxíng le yí cì diàochá.

breakdown: 禁(prohibit)+止(stop) — prohibit and stop

examples.en: Loud talking is forbidden in the library.

examples.py: Jìnzhǐ de shì jiù bié zuò.

khmer: ល្ខោនប៉េកាំង
breakdown: 京(the capital, Beijing)+剧(drama) — drama from the capital

examples.en: I want to watch Peking opera.

examples.py: Jīngjù wǒ tīng bú tài dǒng.
examples.en: I can't understand Peking opera well.

khmer: សេដ្ឋកិច្ច
breakdown: 经(manage)+济(aid, cross over) — managing and providing for people

examples.py: Zhège guójiā de jīngjì hěn hǎo.

examples.en: Taking the subway is more economical.

examples.py: Jīngjì wèntí yǐngxiǎng měi ge rén.

khmer: បទពិសោធន៍ជីវិត
breakdown: 经(pass through)+历(go through) — what you have passed through

examples.py: Zhè shì yí cì nánwàng de jīnglì.
Tā jīnglì le hěn duō kùnnan.
Liúxué de jīnglì gǎibiàn le wǒ.
examples.en: The experience of studying abroad changed me.

examples.cn: 每个人的经历都不一样。
examples.py: Měi ge rén de jīnglì dōu bù yíyàng.
Zhè duàn jīnglì ràng wǒ chéngzhǎng.

breakdown: 经(pass through)+验(test) — what you learned from being tested

examples.en: He has a lot of experience.

examples.py: Wǒ méiyǒu zhè fāngmiàn de jīngyàn.
examples.en: I have no experience in this area.

examples.py: Shībài yě shì yì zhǒng jīngyàn.
examples.en: Failure is also a kind of experience.

breakdown: 精(fine, essence)+彩(colorful) — fine and colorful

examples.cn: 他讲了一个精彩的故事。
examples.py: Tā jiǎng le yí ge jīngcǎi de gùshi.

examples.cn: 精彩的节目吸引了很多观众。
examples.py: Jīngcǎi de jiémù xīyǐn le hěn duō guānzhòng.
examples.en: The brilliant show attracted many viewers.

breakdown: 景(view, scene)+色(color) — the colors of a scene

examples.en: Autumn scenery is the most beautiful.

examples.cn: 我们照了很多景色的照片。
examples.py: Wǒmen zhào le hěn duō jǐngsè de zhàopiàn.
Shān shàng de jǐngsè tèbié měilì.
examples.en: The scenery on the mountain is especially beautiful.

examples.py: Cóng chuānghu kěyǐ kàn dào jǐngsè.
examples.en: You can see the view from the window.

breakdown: 警(warn, alert)+察(examine) — those who watch and warn

examples.py: Jǐngchá zài diàochá zhè jiàn shì.

examples.en: If there's a problem you can find the police.

khmer: ការប្រកួតប្រជែង
breakdown: 竞(compete)+争(fight for) — competing and fighting for it

examples.cn: 我们要跟别的公司竞争。
examples.py: Wǒmen yào gēn bié de gōngsī jìngzhēng.
Zhǎo gōngzuò de jìngzhēng hěn dà.

khmer: ដោយមិននឹកស្មាន
breakdown: 竟(in the end)+然(so) — it turned out so, against expectation

examples.cn: 这么难的题他竟然做对了。
examples.py: Zhème nán de tí tā jìngrán zuò duì le.
examples.en: He actually got such a hard question right.

examples.py: Tā jìngrán yí ge rén qù le.

examples.en: The price actually dropped by half.

breakdown: 镜(mirror, 钅metal radical)+子(noun suffix) — old mirrors were polished metal

examples.en: She is looking in the mirror.
The mirror hangs on the wall.

examples.py: Jìngzi zāng le, yào cā yíxià.
examples.en: The mirror is dirty, wipe it.
There's a mirror in the bathroom.

breakdown: 究(investigate)+竟(in the end) — digging to the very end

examples.cn: 我想知道究竟发生了什么。
examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào jiūjìng fāshēng le shénme.
examples.en: I want to know what actually happened.
Are we going or not, after all?

examples.cn: 这个问题究竟怎么解决？
examples.en: How exactly do we solve this problem?

breakdown: Whole shape — hands lifting something up

examples.py: Zhège xiāngzi wǒ jǔ bu qǐlái.
Zhīdào dá'àn de qǐng jǔ shǒu.
examples.en: Raise your hand if you know the answer.

breakdown: 举(raise up)+办(handle) — putting on and running an event

examples.py: Xuéxiào jǔbàn le yí ge huódòng.
Tāmen jǔbàn le yì chǎng bǐsài.

examples.cn: 这个城市要举办国际会议。
examples.py: Zhège chéngshì yào jǔbàn guójì huìyì.
examples.en: This city will host an international conference.

examples.cn: 举办活动需要很多准备。
examples.py: Jǔbàn huódòng xūyào hěn duō zhǔnbèi.
examples.en: Holding an event takes much preparation.
The company holds a party every year.

breakdown: 举(raise up)+行(carry out) — carrying out an occasion

examples.en: The match is held in the gymnasium.
The graduation ceremony is next week.

examples.cn: 这个活动每年举行一次。
examples.py: Zhège huódòng měinián jǔxíng yí cì.
examples.en: This event is held once a year.

breakdown: 拒(resist, 扌hand radical)+绝(cut off) — pushing away and cutting off

examples.py: Tā jùjué le wǒ de jiànyì.

examples.en: She refused to accept the bonus.
Learning to say no is also important.

breakdown: 距(distance)+离(apart from) — how far apart things are

examples.en: The distance is about ten kilometers.

examples.py: Liǎng ge chéngshì de jùlí hěn jìn.
examples.en: The two cities are close in distance.

examples.py: Jùlí kǎoshì hái yǒu yí ge yuè.
examples.en: There's still a month until the exam.

breakdown: 聚(gather)+会(meet) — gathering and meeting

examples.en: You should dress up for a party.

breakdown: 开(start)+玩笑(joke) — starting a joke

examples.en: Don't make this kind of joke.

examples.py: Nǐ shì bu shì zài kāi wánxiào?

examples.cn: 开玩笑也要注意别人的感情。
examples.py: Kāi wánxiào yě yào zhùyì biéren de gǎnqíng.

khmer: សប្បាយចិត្ត
breakdown: 开(open)+心(heart) — an open heart

examples.py: Jiàn dào nǐ wǒ hěn kāixīn.

breakdown: 看(look)+法(way) — your way of looking at it

examples.cn: 每个人都有自己的看法。
examples.py: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de kànfǎ.

breakdown: 考(examine)+虑(ponder, 心heart at bottom) — examining with the heart

examples.en: I need to think it over.

examples.cn: 我们要考虑价格和质量。
examples.py: Wǒmen yào kǎolǜ jiàgé hé zhìliàng.
examples.en: We must consider price and quality.

breakdown: 烤(roast, 火fire radical)+鸭(duck) — roasted duck

examples.en: I want to eat roast duck.

examples.py: Zhè jiā cāntīng de kǎoyā zuì hǎo.
examples.en: This restaurant's roast duck is the best.

examples.py: Wǒ dì yī cì chī kǎoyā.
examples.en: It's my first time eating roast duck.

khmer: វិទ្យាសាស្ត្រ
breakdown: 科(branch, subject)+学(study) — the study of subjects

khmer: ដើម (សម្រាប់រុក្ខជាតិ)
breakdown: 木(tree radical)+果(sound guǒ/kē) — used for counting plants

examples.en: There is a tree at the door.

examples.py: Wǒ zhòng le sān kē huā.
Nà kē shù yǒu yìbǎi nián le.
examples.en: That tree is a hundred years old.

examples.py: Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō kē shù.
examples.en: There are many trees in the park.

breakdown: 咳(cough, 口mouth radical)+嗽(cough, 口mouth radical) — both use the mouth radical

examples.en: After catching a cold I started coughing.

examples.py: Késou le sān tiān, yào kàn dàifu.
examples.en: Coughing for three days, you should see a doctor.

khmer: គួរឲ្យអាណិត
breakdown: 可(able to be)+怜(pity, 忄heart radical) — able to be pitied

examples.py: Zhè zhī xiǎo gǒu hěn kělián.

examples.en: I feel sorry for that child.

breakdown: 可(can)+是(be) — 'it can be, but...'

examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng qù, kěshì méi shíjiān.
examples.en: I want to go, but I have no time.

examples.py: Zhège cài hǎochī, kěshì tài guì.
examples.en: This dish is tasty, but too expensive.

examples.py: Tā hěn lèi, kěshì hái zài gōngzuò.
examples.en: He is tired, but still working.

examples.cn: 我学了很久，可是还不会说。
examples.py: Wǒ xué le hěn jiǔ, kěshì hái bú huì shuō.
examples.en: I studied long, but still can't speak.
The weather is fine, but a bit cold.
